Validation and independent testing

The 204 synchronized test groups are a selected subset with informative visual alignment checks within three frames. Their score does not apply to all test clips. Synchronization is visually estimated, without hardware-clock ground truth.

Independent test by camera

A SEPARATE TEST POPULATION

19 unseen drivers. 16 actions.

32 training drivers · 8 validation drivers · 19 independent test drivers. No test-driven training, threshold tuning or checkpoint selection.

The test evaluates one deterministic centre window and crop per labelled clip. Classification scores do not measure full-video temporal localization.

PRIVATE GPU INFERENCE

A simple path from video to prediction.

One uploaded video per job, with persistent progress, cancellation and downloadable predictions.

Connect to the private GPU service through the local SSH tunnel. This hosted HTTPS website requires a reachable HTTPS GPU API. Samples and local preview remain available without a connection.
01

One video in

Choose a camera viewpoint and one browser-compatible MP4, MOV or WebM. Initial limits: 512 MiB and five minutes per video. The server will independently validate the bytes.

02

One GPU worker

Validate the source and checkpoint, decode the video and run deterministic inference. Process one job at a time; show progress from actual completed windows.

03

An inspectable result

Return timestamped 16-class scores, top predictions and checkpoint provenance. Keep labels, when available, separate from predictions.

Connection approach

PRIVATE SERVICE

First verify the service through a local SSH tunnel. Connecting this hosted HTTPS website requires a reachable HTTPS GPU API with authentication and the exact website origin allowed.

A single video needs no cross-camera synchronization. Videos will be accepted individually; a three-camera upload will not be required.

Your server jobs

One active video job; up to 10 retained jobs. Terminal jobs expire after 24 hours. A 2 GiB free-space reserve is enforced. Downloads contain predictions, not the uploaded video.

Connect the GPU backend to view your jobs.
